name: krafttraining-tracker
description: Krafttraining Tracker als PWA und native Android-App mit Capacitor

scripts.build: node scripts/build-web.mjs && tailwindcss -i ./css/tailwind.css -o ./www/css/tailwind.css --minify && npm run verify:web
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
